blocks.text: Five days after the passenger ferry MV June Aster caught fire off the coast of Coron, Palawan, claiming at least 76 lives, its captain finally emerged in public, ending speculations that he, too, had perished in the accident. Roel Sarmiento first appeared at the Palawan office of the ship’s operator, Atienza Interisland Ferries Inc., before being brought by the company’s human resources manager to authorities, who had been looking for Sarmiento since the disaster on Sept. 9.
